correctness.rationale: Iid continuous priorities induce a uniform edge order. After the first legal edge, deleting edges touching its endpoints leaves a uniform relative order on the survivors, so the available-edge recurrence is exact by induction. An independently written rational transfer on the specified GP(10,2) reproduced all five probabilities for K=6 through 10, total mass one, the expectation 42002246692500247/4862914056000000, and terminal occupied-mask counts 5,420,1310,160,1. Exhaustive enumeration confirmed independence number eight and the five listed independent eight-sets. For each, the complement induces a six-edge matching; each of its edges must precede its four crossing edges to leave this set vacant. Conversely, these conditions force exactly that matching by induction in arrival order. The six races partition the edge set, giving 5/5^6 across the five disjoint possibilities. A jammed uncovered set is independent and the spokes witness the perfect-matching endpoint. The classical five cubes yield independent eight-sets (cube chord lengths exceed the dodecahedron edge length), so the exhaustive five-set count identifies these sets geometrically.
residual_risks: Terminal counts aggregate occupied masks, not labeled matching edge sets. No finite-time or chemical predictions are verified.
